silhouette.reason: Mantle, eyes, eight curling arms with sucker rows: unmistakable; arm poses vary more now.
fixes: two arms curled under the body so TOP is less of a symmetric star

proportions.reason: Arms taper and the web is visible, but a cylindrical neck collar with a seam separates the head from the arm crown in hero.png, which a real octopus does not show.
fixes: blend the head into the arm crown (remove the collar ring) in anatomy.ts
enlarge the inter-arm web toward the base

materials.reason: Wet sheen on the skin and pale sucker rims read well; the papillae are uniform pale dots that read like studs.
fixes: papillae in skin colour with only a slight value lift, varied size

detail.reason: Suckers sized down toward the tips, papillae, eye with a slit pupil; the arm tops are smooth with no skin folds.
fixes: skin folds and wrinkles along the arm tops and around the eye

wear.reason: Pristine: no regenerating arm tip, no healed scars.
fixes: one shorter regenerating arm tip and a few healed scars (seeded)

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps all eight arms and the curls; the mantle and arm colour break into blocky patches.
fixes: smooth the LOD2 colour per face (average of LOD0) and add rings to the mantle
move LOD0 triangles from sucker rims on the hidden underside to the mantle
